finding: Occupant interface shows a live response counter; Council interface labels each submission's status and attempt number

nielsen_heuristic: Match between system and the real world
finding: Occupant-facing domains use everyday language; administrator and Council interfaces use certification terminology appropriate to that audience
Completion and confirmation gates prevent accidental submission, but no interface offers a way to withdraw or revise an attempt once sent
Shared card layout, color coding, and iconography recur across all three interfaces and across domains within an interface
Dual-gate logic prevents an attempt from being sent until all occupant domains are rated and the administrator has confirmed a pre-submission preview
Domain cards pair an icon with a label and description; badge criteria list explicit pass/fail checkmarks rather than requiring recall of a threshold
Climate-zone leaderboard, survey-period filter, and team role management were added directly in response to a usability-testing finding
The administrator's domain-detail view remains dense after the expandable-tabs revision reduced, but did not eliminate, information density

nielsen_heuristic: Help users recognize, diagnose, and recover from errors
finding: The remediation list states the failed measurement, the standard it was measured against, typical effort, and credit at stake for each under-credited domain
No interface provides in-context help, such as a glossary of domain terms or an explanation of the weighting schema
